up: Retrieve distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in Homo sapiens assays against target CHEMBL284 (Dipeptidyl peptidase 4). Filter on assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens' and return only the distinct molecule_chembl_id and canonical_smiles columns.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles FROM assays a JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE a.tid = (SELECT tid FROM target_dictionary WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL284') AND a.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens';
